title: Oostende celebrate Pro Basketball League title
description: Antwerp - Oostende 71-74 Oostende celebrated Pro Basketball League title. They defeated Antwerp Giants on the road in Game 4 to clinch the trophy. Antwerp Giants trailed by 12 points after 3 quarters before a 24-15 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 71-74 at the end of the game. American guard Khalil-Ullah Ahmad (191-1996, college: CS Fullerton) fired 29 points for the winners. The other American import forward Damien Jefferson (196-1997, college: Creighton, agency: Octagon Europe) chipped in 12 points. Oostende's coach Dario Gjergja used an eleven-player rotation in such tough game. Serbian power forward Nikola Jovanovic (211-1994, college: USC) produced 12 points and 7 rebounds and American guard Rasir Bolton (190-1999, college: Gonzaga, agency: Octagon Europe) added 14 points and 4 assists (made all of his seven free throws) respectively for lost side.
